in_marathi.name: Harmeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harmeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Har means 'God' and Meet means 'nectar'. This name is derived from the Hindu mythology where the Gods and Demons churned the ocean to obtain Amrit, the elixir of immortality. Harmeet refers to the nectar obtained from this process.
